title: Hot Smoked Vietnamese Bresaola Bun Thit Nuong
description: A garlicky and dense Vietnamese dish featuring bresaola, served in a ti leaf wrap, this romantic meal is perfect for special occasions. It is a satvik friendly and smoke hot dish.
instructions: Preheat the smoker to 225 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together garlic, fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, and black pepper.
Add the mixture to the bresaola and marinate for at least 2 hours.
Remove the bresaola from the marinade and place it in the smoker.
Smoke the bresaola for 4 hours or until it reaches an internal temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the bresaola is smoking, prepare the ti leaves by washing and drying them.
Once the bresaola is done, slice it thinly against the grain.
To assemble the dish, place a few slices of the bresaola onto a ti leaf, drizzle with vegetable oil, and serve immediately.
